'''Naga Sadow's poison blade''' was the name given to a type of [[Sith war sword]] created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]].<ref name="Codex"/> The blade was imbued with a lethal [[Poison/Legends|poison]] which would then be inflicted upon victims who were attacked with the blade. The weapon was said to be imbued by the tainted presence of Naga Sadow.

Centuries after Sadow's death, one of these swords was found in the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during his [[Skirmish on Korriban|infiltration]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] archaeologist [[Talos Drellik]] knew of several other swords of this type still in existence during the [[Third Galactic War]], with some specifically located on [[Khar Shian]].
